hook.name: FloodHook
hook.description: A custom single-sided AMM hook that acts as a bonding-curve market for the FLOOD token against WETH, USDC, and USDT. It fully overrides swap execution via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, computing prices with a constant-product formula using deposited Aave aTokens as the reserve, and charges a 30 bps base fee plus a gas-priority MEV fee. External LP deposits and donations are blocked.
